g.text: End-to-End Enterprise System Topology: Client App (React Native/Web) ➔ BFF API ➔ Foundry Agent Service ➔ Multi-Agent Orchestration & Tools
• Billed: Model Tokens + Tool Usage Only
• Best for: Standard Q&A, RAG, Basic Tasks
Connects to remote MCP Servers & Functions
Direction A: n8n HTTP Request ➔ BFF API
n8n triggers on SaaS event & calls Agent
Direction B: Agent ➔ n8n Webhook / OpenAPI
Agent calls n8n workflow as an Action Tool
Decoupled: Deterministic Flow vs AI Reasoning
Successor to Semantic Kernel & AutoGen • 5 Production-Ready Orchestration Patterns (Python / .NET):
• Visual Declarative Workflows RETIRE Dec 1, 2026 ➔ All production multi-agent pipelines must use Agent Framework or Logic Apps.
• AutoGen is in maintenance mode; Semantic Kernel v1.x succeeded by Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA.
• OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing across API, Orchestrator & Models
• Agent Monitoring Dashboard: Latency, Tokens, Tool Calls, Success Rate & Exceptions
• Automatic Tracing collection for Agent Framework, LangGraph & External Agents
Agent Guardrails & Azure AI Content Safety
• 4 Intervention Points: User Input, Tool Call (Preview), Tool Response, Output
• Protection against: Prompt Injections, Jailbreaks, PII leakage & Hate/Violence
• Penancia.S Guard: Rejects hallucinated numbers; falls back to deterministic template
🇦🇪 UAE Regional Data Locality & Clinical Safety Gate
• Data Residency: No identifiable patient health data leaves UAE North region
• Decision Boundary: AI NEVER makes diagnostic decisions or alters numerical values
• Deterministic C# Domain rules (WHO 2021) hold absolute clinical precedence
1. Client Separation: React Native & Web clients talk ONLY to your ASP.NET / Container Apps API (BFF) with user tokens; never directly to Foundry.
2. Zero Credentials: Backend uses Microsoft Entra Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) with "Foundry User" RBAC role. No API keys.
3. Modern Runtime: Use Agent Service v2 (Responses API, Conversations, Agent Versions) + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 (Retire classic/assistants).
4. Hybrid Automation: Keep deterministic workflows in Logic Apps/Durable Functions/n8n; use Foundry agents strictly for open-ended reasoning & tools.
